name: testkube
description: testkube — Kubernetes-native testing framework. Run and manage tests (Postman, cypress, curl, k6) in k8s clusters.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/kubeshop/testkube/releases/latest/download/testkube_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf testkube_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv testkube /usr/local/bin/ && rm testkube_linux_amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
